title: Logos peri nepseos kai phylakes kardias (On Watchfulness and the Guarding of the Heart)
author: Nikephoros the Monk (Nikephoros the Hesychast)
summary: Nikephoros's anthology of patristic sayings on attention, ending with his own method: sit, collect the mind, lead it in with the breath through the nostrils into the heart, keep it there with the Jesus Prayer; if this fails, repeat the prayer in the 'reasoning faculty' in the chest until the heart's entrance opens. The fruits named are joy, love, peace. No seen light is described or promised.
why_relevant: Seed lead: the classic hesychast psychophysical method; checked for any light content.
